willNever: DM you first. On X, Discord, Telegram, or anywhere. Including a reply in a thread you started.
Ask for your seed phrase, private key, or keystore file. Not for support, not for a migration, not for a whitelist, not to verify anything.
Ask you to connect your wallet to claim, verify, unlock, migrate, or fix anything.

Run a claim, an airdrop, or a distribution. There is no claim page, no claim program deployed, and no claim of any kind. Any page offering to distribute $ESCAPEMENT to you is fraudulent, without exception.
Run a presale, whitelist, private round, or allocation. The token launches on pump.fun with no allocation to us beyond a dev buy from the wallet published above.
Announce a migration, a V2 token, or a contract fix requiring you to swap tokens.
Ask you to send SOL or any token to any address, for any reason.
Publish a new contract address. There is exactly one launch and one mint. If an address changes, we have been compromised — and the on-chain memo chain will disagree with the new claim.
Run a giveaway that requires a transaction.
Offer private support. There is no support DM, no ticket bot, no support agent. Every support request is answered in public or not at all.
Contact you about unclaimed rewards, a failed transaction, or an account issue.
Ask you to install software, join a call to debug, or download a file.
notEvidence: A matching name, symbol, or image. All three are free to copy and none are unique.
A Solscan, Dexscreener or Birdeye listing. Every token has one, including every scam.
Liquidity, volume, or holder count. All purchasable.
A verified checkmark on any social platform. Paid checkmarks verify a payment, not an identity.
Being first in search results. Ads outrank truth.
memoChainNote: The memo chain is served separately and is NOT part of this document, because a document cannot contain the hash of itself. This document changes only when the record changes; each change is attested by the next memo.
disclosure: Creator fees accrue at an address no one can sign for. The program that would distribute them has failed three independent security reviews and is not deployed. If it never passes, these fees are permanently unclaimable by anyone, including us. The reviews are published.
